description: This file defines the ShippingSummary class, which models shipping fee details including shipping costs, handling, shipping module, options, and applicable flags for free shipping and taxes.

classes.name: ShippingSummary
classes.description: Class representing a summary of shipping costs and options, serializable for Java object transmission and stored data.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Returns the shipping cost as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: getHandling
methods.description: Returns the handling fee as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: isFreeShipping
methods.description: Returns whether free shipping is applied.

methods.name: isTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Returns whether tax applies to shipping.

methods.name: setTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Sets the tax on shipping flag.
